primary.report_quote:
## Guidance vs Actuals

This section reports the frozen initial FY2025 capex guidance for Amazon, Alphabet, and Meta only, as captured on February 7, 2025 — the first full-year 2025 guidance issued after FY2024 results. This is a historical snapshot; later revisions are not substituted, and guidance is kept strictly separate from reported FY2025 actuals [S1].

| Company | Initial FY2025 Capex Guidance | Release Date | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Amazon | ~$100B | 2025-02-06 (Q4 2024 earnings call) | Management estimate of capital expenditures [S1] |
| Alphabet | ~$75B | 2025-02-04 (Q4 2024 earnings call) | Reported capex; cash-payment timing able to cause variability [S1] |
| Meta | $60B–$65B | 2025-01-29 (Q4 and full-year 2024 results) | Includes principal payments on finance leases [S1] |

**Meta basis caveat:** Meta's guidance of $60B–$65B includes finance-lease principal payments, whereas the XBRL cash-capex actual in this source pack is cash paid to acquire property and equipment and excludes finance-lease principal. A percentage variance against Meta's guidance is therefore not like-for-like and is not calculated here [S1].

**Unavailable guidance:** No initial FY2025 capex guidance is provided in this frozen source pack for Microsoft, NVIDIA, or Apple; it is reported as unavailable rather than estimated [S1].
primary.reasoning: The report has a separate guidance section and explicitly states guidance is kept separate from FY2025 actuals. It also explains Meta's basis mismatch and says no variance is calculated. Although the local citation is [S1], the supplied supporting raw evidence is only resolved under source_id S5 and entails the key unavailable-guidance and Meta-basis statements required by the rubric.

For its most recent fiscal year (FY2025, FYE Dec), Amazon reported revenue of $716.9B, an operating margin of 11.2%, operating cash flow of $139.5B, and capital expenditures of $131.8B. Free cash flow was $7.7B and capex represented 94% of operating cash flow. Over FY2020-FY2025, reported capex moved from $40.1B to $131.8B.

For its most recent fiscal year (FY2025, FYE Dec), Alphabet reported revenue of $402.8B, an operating margin of 32.0%, operating cash flow of $164.7B, and capital expenditures of $91.4B. Free cash flow was $73.3B and capex represented 56% of operating cash flow. Over FY2020-FY2025, reported capex moved from $22.3B to $91.4B.

## Meta
For its most recent fiscal year (FY2025, FYE Dec), Meta reported revenue of $201.0B, an operating margin of 41.4%, operating cash flow of $115.8B, and capital expenditures of $69.7B. ## NVIDIA
For its most recent fiscal year (FY2025, FYE Jan), NVIDIA reported revenue of $130.5B, an operating margin of 62.4%, operating cash flow of $64.1B, and capital expenditures of $3.2B. Free cash flow was $60.9B and capex represented 5% of operating cash flow. Over FY2022-FY2025, reported capex moved from $1.0B to $3.2B.
